name: Her Vengeance
overview: Julia, Chairwoman of the Clark Group, has been married to her husband Tom for years without having children—turns out Tom has been secretly drugging her with infertility pills! Even more, he's embezzling funds from her Group to provide his mistress! Julia teams up with Tom's ex Cathy, make Cathy over to be a wealthy widow to set a trap and take revenge on the scumbag. Her one-and-only love William also shows up with a billion-dollar capital to back them up, and even Abigail, the mistress dumped by Tom, is a secret heiress... The group joins forces, determined to make the scumbag pay for what he's done. But after all that she's suffered, will Julia still have the courage to seize the true happiness that belongs to her?
